findings.description: The positional-arguments help section now passes Argument.get_help_record() rows straight to write_dl, but that method returns (metavar, None) when the argument has no help text. The old `or (metavar, "")` fallback that covered this case was removed.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one positional argument that has help and another positional argument with no help, so help is None. Any help output then reaches write_dl with a None description. The formatter is expected to wrap a string there, so it likely raises (for example AttributeError) or renders incorrectly. Impact: `--help` crashes or prints a broken Positional arguments section for such commands, which are common.
